Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability in Redis servers to gain remote code execution
Scans port 6379 to find exposed Redis instances
Executes commands such as INFO, SLAVEOF, REPLCONF, PSYNC, and MODULE LOAD to exploit the vulnerability and gain control of the system
Collects host hardware information using command execution capabilities
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability in the Lua scripting engine of Redis
Port scanning (port 6379) to identify exposed Redis instances
Command execution to create replicas and load malicious modules
Indicators of Compromise: Use of commands such as INFO, SLAVEOF, REPLCONF, PSYNC, MODULE LOAD, and SLAVEOF NO ONE
Redis server turned into a master after disabling replication
